subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"rewarding".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word **"rewarding" **means giving a feeling of satisfaction or fulfillment.

 
 
• **Example: **I find teaching to be a **rewarding **career because I get to help students learn and grow.
 
 
 
• This option fits well in the context of the sentence, indicating that the blank is being filled with a positive word.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"insignificant" **means not important or noteworthy. This word has a negative connotation and does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **"pointless" **means having no purpose or value. This word has a negative connotation and does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **"customizing" **means modifying something to fit a particular individual or group. This word does not fit the context of the sentence as it does not convey any positive or negative connotation.
